title: sou350121/VLA-Handbook
summary: VLA-Handbook is a Chinese, practice-oriented learning and interview guide for algorithm engineers entering Vision-Language-Action robotics. It narrows the usual CV/NLP preparation lens to robotics-specific issues, making it useful as a structured entry point for people trying to understand what matters technically in VLA systems.

title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
summary: PACE targets sim-to-real transfer for legged robots by systematically identifying actuator and joint dynamics using only standard joint encoders, rather than relying on specialized sensing or hand-tuned modeling. The repo is useful for making simulated legged-robot behavior better match hardware, especially where unmodeled drivetrain and joint effects are a major source of transfer failure.

extra.full_text: PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

title: google-deepmind/mujoco_playground
summary: MuJoCo Playground is an open-source library for training robot policies with GPU-accelerated simulation and carrying them toward sim-to-real deployment. It is useful as infrastructure for robot learning experiments where fast MuJoCo rollouts, scalable reinforcement learning, and transfer-oriented workflows matter more than hand-building the simulation stack from scratch.

extra.full_text: An open-source library for GPU-accelerated robot learning and sim-to-real transfer.

title: iit-DLSLab/sim2real-robot-identification
summary: A joint calibration routine helps align simulated quadrupeds and manipulators with their real hardware counterparts, targeting sim-to-real transfer from Isaac Lab and MuJoCo. It is meant as a practical identification step for robotics workflows where small joint-parameter mismatches can undermine policies or controllers trained in simulation.

extra.full_text: A joints calibration routine for quadrupeds and manipulators to facilitate sim-to-real transfer from isaaclab and mujoco to real robots

title: NVIDIA/warp
summary: NVIDIA Warp is a Python framework for writing GPU-accelerated simulation and computation kernels, aimed at robotics, physics simulation, and machine learning workflows. It is useful when researchers need fast differentiable or large-scale simulation components without dropping fully into low-level CUDA code.

extra.full_text: A Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, robotics, and machine learning.

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: IsaacLab-Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with a composable simulation layer for building robot-learning environments from interchangeable robots, objects, task setups, and scene configurations. It is aimed at quickly prototyping and scaling policy evaluation across diverse embodiments and environments, making it useful for testing whether learned robotic behaviors generalize beyond a single hand-crafted simulator setup.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: iit-DLSLab/basic-locomotion-isaaclab
summary: An IsaacLab DirectEnv implementation for training and evaluating basic quadruped locomotion, with configurations for multiple robot platforms rather than a single hard-coded body. It is useful as a starting point for reinforcement-learning locomotion experiments that need to move beyond simulation-only demos, since it includes paths for sim-to-sim transfer and eventual sim-to-real deployment.

extra.full_text: An IsaacLab DirectEnv for basic quadrupedal locomotion tasks, with support for multiple quadruped robots, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real pipelines

title: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab
summary: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab is a tutorial-oriented codebase for training robot behaviors with reinforcement learning and imitation learning on ROBOTIS platforms. It is aimed at the practical path from simulated training to real robot deployment, with Sim2Real support for moving learned policies onto physical hardware.

extra.full_text: This repository provides tutorials for reinforcement learning and imitation learning using ROBOTIS robots, and supports Sim2Real functionality for deploying the learned policies on real robots.

title: RobotControlStack/robot-control-stack
summary: RobotControlStack is a lightweight sim-to-real stack for training and deploying VLA models and reinforcement learning agents without depending on ROS. It provides native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution across several common robot platforms, including Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101, and YAM, making it useful for researchers who want a leaner path from simulation experiments to real robot control.

extra.full_text: A lean, ROS-free sim-to-real framework for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and RL agents. Native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution for Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101 and YAM.

title: facebookresearch/project_superdex
summary: SuperDex is a unified robotics simulation platform from facebookresearch that combines a purpose-built physics engine, authoring tools, and a scalable reinforcement learning interface. It is aimed at building and training dexterous robot behaviors in simulation, with VR teleoperation already part of the workflow and more capabilities planned for later releases.

extra.full_text: SuperDex brings together a purpose-built physics engine, robotics authoring tools, and a scalable reinforcement learning interface in a unified simulation platform, with VR-based teleoperation and additional capabilities planned for future releases.

title: wadeKeith/Awesome-Embodied-AI
summary: wadeKeith/Awesome-Embodied-AI is a curated index for embodied AI, collecting surveys, vision-language-action models, datasets, simulators, humanoid projects, robot learning resources, and safety material in one place. It is useful as a fast orientation map for researchers tracking the field, especially when comparing available model families, benchmarks, simulation environments, and adjacent safety work.

extra.full_text: Curated embodied AI list: surveys, VLA models, datasets, simulators, humanoids, robot learning, and safety resources.

title: iit-DLSLab/fault-locomotion-isaaclab
summary: IsaacLab DirectEnv setup for training and testing quadruped locomotion policies when one or more motors fail. It supports multiple robot platforms and is meant to carry policies through simulation-to-simulation checks and onward to sim-to-real deployment, making it useful for studying fault-tolerant legged locomotion under actuator damage.

extra.full_text: An IsaacLab DirectEnv for quadrupedal locomotion under motor failures, with support for multiple quadruped robots, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real pipelines

title: AsterisCrack/BipedRobot
summary: A biped locomotion codebase built around Isaac Lab and MuJoCo, with custom implementations of PPO, SAC, DDPG, D4PG, and MPO for training walking policies. It supports MLP, LSTM, and Transformer policies, motion imitation, and sim-to-real workflows, making it useful as a practical sandbox for comparing deep RL controllers and deployment pipelines on legged robots.

title: open-edge-platform/physical-ai-studio
summary: Physical AI Studio provides an end-to-end imitation-learning workflow for training robots from human demonstrations. It is aimed at making the full pipeline usable in one place, from collecting demonstrations through training policies that let a robot reproduce task behavior.

extra.full_text: Physical AI Studio is an end-to-end framework for training robots to perform tasks through imitation learning from human demonstrations.

title: castacks/AirStack
summary: AirStack is an agent-native framework for moving embodied AI from simulation to field robots with a closed-loop workflow that mirrors the target hardware one-to-one. Its emphasis is rapid sim-to-real deployment with self-validation, making it useful for robotics teams that need to iterate autonomy stacks against hardware behavior rather than treat simulation and deployment as separate worlds.

extra.full_text: Agent-native framework for rapid sim-to-real deployment of embodied AI for field robotics. Closed-loop, one-to-one workflow with hardware, self validating. Checkout develop branch for latest features.

title: cair-vinuni/FoldQuantVLA
summary: FoldQuantVLA provides offline layer folding to make vision-language-action models run with W4A4 or W8A8 quantization on edge GPUs. It appears aimed at shrinking inference cost for robot policies while preserving deployability, with the repo focused on the practical quantization path rather than training a new VLA model.

extra.full_text: FoldQuant: offline folding for W4A4 / W8A8 vision-language-action inference on edge GPUs

title: kuds/mesozoic-labs
summary: Mesozoic Labs is an open-source platform for studying dinosaur biomechanics through robotic locomotion, built around MuJoCo-based Gymnasium environments. It uses reinforcement learning with curriculum training, W&B experiment tracking, and an explicit path toward sim-to-real transfer, making it useful for testing how extinct body plans might move and for turning those simulations into embodied robotic behaviors.

extra.full_text: Open-source research platform for dinosaur biomechanics and robotic locomotion using reinforcement learning. MuJoCo-based Gymnasium environments with curriculum learning, W&B experiment tracking, and sim-to-real transfer goals.
